note: The Sunweaver's staff, tier III (elite), hand-authored at 1 texel a px: a dark stained shaft in gilt fittings on a steel spike in a gilt shoe, a gilt-wired grip, a gilt band, a cross-bar finial hung with two gilt chains ending in cream beads, a gilt collar and cup, and a 7 px gilt sun on eight long gilt rays; the heart is one 1 px cube, lit on its north and south faces (2 glow texels); 34 px long.
